STORIES.headline: Thomas Markle indicted on child sex abuse material charges
STORIES.summary: A federal grand jury in Los Angeles indicted Thomas Markle on charges of possessing child sexual abuse material, including photos of prepubescent children.
article: A federal grand jury in Los Angeles indicted Thomas Markle on charges of possessing child sexual abuse material, including photos of prepubescent children. Thomas Wayne Markle, 82, faces up to 40 years in prison if convicted, as stated by Los Angeles federal prosecutor Bill Essayli. Markle was arrested in early November after federal authorities discovered dozens of illicit images, including film negatives and slides, in a Los Angeles storage facility. Court documents allege Markle also possessed such material in the Philippines, where he owns a home and some images appear to have been taken there.

Markle is expected to appear in Los Angeles court in the coming weeks. FBI agents detained Markle on November 6 after seizing a large amount of material from two storage units he rented in Los Angeles over nearly two decades. Markle came under investigation after his son, Thomas Markle Jr., reported illegal images found in his father’s belongings in Cebu City to the police in the Philippines.
STORIES.imageAlt: Mugshot of Thomas Markle in an orange shirt

STORIES.headline: China’s Huawei convicted of stealing US trade secrets
STORIES.summary: A US federal jury convicted Huawei on 10 of 12 criminal counts, including trade secret theft and bank fraud, in a case alleging deception about its Iran business.
article: A US federal jury convicted Huawei on 10 of 12 criminal counts, including trade secret theft and bank fraud, in a case alleging deception about its Iran business.

Huawei rejected the charges as lacking legal or factual basis, while a US jury found it guilty on 10 of 12 counts related to trade secret theft and bank deception. After a three-month trial, a federal jury in Brooklyn convicted Huawei on multiple counts, including conspiracy to steal trade secrets, wire fraud, and money laundering.
STORIES.imageAlt: China’s Huawei convicted of stealing US trade secrets

STORIES.headline: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO following “input” from US government
STORIES.summary: Nvidia's board unanimously voted to reinstate Jensen Huang after US authorities indicated no national security risk, amid reports of a personal affair with a suspected Chinese spy.
article: Nvidia's board unanimously voted to reinstate Jensen Huang after US authorities indicated no national security risk, amid reports of a personal affair with a suspected Chinese spy. As co-founder of Nvidia, Jensen Huang remains a central figure in the company driving AI advancements across the US tech sector.

Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, president, and board director immediately, after determining with US officials that the move poses no national security risk. The board voted unanimously to reinstate Huang after discussions with him, citing his candor and leadership capabilities as key reasons, with the decision finalized Monday.
STORIES.imageAlt: A split screen image. On the left, Faisal Islam. On the right, Jensen Huang.

STORIES.headline: Huang apologizes to Nvidia employees, says he’s in therapy: Reports
STORIES.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologized to employees and admitted he was in therapy daily during his first all-hands meeting after returning to the company.
article: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologized to employees and admitted he was in therapy daily during his first all-hands meeting after returning to the company. Huang admitted to making serious mistakes and confessed to being unfaithful to his wife during a meeting with employees, as reported by The New York Times.

At Nvidia’s first all-hands meeting since CEO Jensen Huang’s return on Monday, he apologized to employees and confirmed he was attending therapy daily. Huang announced he would attend therapy daily and plan monthly feedback sessions with staff, according to attendees at the meeting on Monday.
STORIES.imageAlt: Huang apologizes to Nvidia employees, says he’s in therapy: Reports

STORIES.headline: COP31 collapse has shattered the pretence of a global climate consensus
STORIES.summary: After a week of tense negotiations, COP31 concluded without agreement on 22 November, as the UK and EU refused to endorse a draft text that failed to mention fossil fuels.
article: After a week of tense negotiations, COP31 concluded without agreement on 22 November, as the UK and EU refused to endorse a draft text that failed to mention fossil fuels.

The failure to include fossil fuels in the draft agreement became the central point of contention. The EU led a coordinated push against the proposed text, undermining the consensus required to finalize a global climate agreement. Amid worsening climate disasters and a confirmed trajectory past 1.5°C warming, the EU and allies argued the international process was no longer adequate to meet the crisis.
STORIES.imageAlt: Fossil fuel dispute leaves COP31 without an overarching agreement

STORIES.headline: US To Blacklist Asian AI Firm Megaspeed After Nvidia Scandal
STORIES.summary: Allegations that a former Megaspeed executive had a romantic relationship with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang while acting as a Chinese intelligence asset prompted the Commerce Department's investigation, which began nearly two years ago.
article: Allegations that a former Megaspeed executive had a romantic relationship with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang while acting as a Chinese intelligence asset prompted the Commerce Department's investigation, which began nearly two years ago. Megaspeed, a data center developer, faces a U.S. trade ban after a former executive was accused of spying for China during a relationship with Nvidia’s CEO, Jensen Huang.

The Trump administration added Megaspeed to a U.S. trade blacklist, preventing it from accessing American semiconductors and tech products following links to the Nvidia scandal. Megaspeed is now barred from receiving U.S. tech goods, software, or services without a license, as part of the Commerce Department’s entity blacklist. Semafor first reported that the Singapore-based AI infrastructure firm, known for powering AI training data centers, has been added to the U.S. entity list.
STORIES.imageAlt: Logo of Megaspeed is pictured on a window outside one of the company's offices.

STORIES.headline: ‘Illegal migrant’ among two men arrested after break-in at William and Catherine’s home
STORIES.summary: Norfolk Police are investigating a break-in at Anmer Hall, a 10-bedroom retreat gifted by Queen Elizabeth II to William and Kate after their wedding.
article: Norfolk Police are investigating a break-in at Anmer Hall, a 10-bedroom retreat gifted by Queen Elizabeth II to William and Kate after their wedding. One of the arrested men is believed to be Albanian, having previously submitted an asylum application that has since expired.

Police deployed dogs, drones, and a helicopter to the Sandringham estate after a call of suspicious activity was received just before 6pm on Monday. Anmer Hall, where William and Kate and their children often stay, especially during holidays, was the site of the reported break-in. The 10-bedroom Georgian manor was given to the couple by Queen Elizabeth II as a wedding gift.
STORIES.imageAlt: Anmer Hall, a Georgian red brick building over three storeys, with grass and trees visible out front.

STORIES.headline: U.S. Prepares to Raise Tariffs On China and Others
STORIES.summary: U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer is expected to reveal findings from a monthslong investigation into industrial subsidies from China, the EU, and 14 other nations by early next week.
article: U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer is expected to reveal findings from a monthslong investigation into industrial subsidies from China, the EU, and 14 other nations by early next week.

The Trump administration is expected to announce new tariffs on China, the EU, and 14 other countries, according to two sources familiar with the plans. The U.S. Trade Representative’s Office is set to release results of a monthslong probe into industrial subsidies from 16 nations, with the announcement expected in the coming days. The timing of the new tariff announcement may still shift, as the White House and USTR have not commented on the plans. The proposed tariffs are part of a broader effort to replace last year’s duties that were invalidated by the Supreme Court.
STORIES.imageAlt: U.S. Prepares to Raise Tariffs On China and Others

STORIES.headline: Can we make our disability benefits system work better and cost less?
STORIES.summary: The disability benefits system is under review, with critics saying it is outdated and costly, and that improvements are long overdue.
article: The disability benefits system is under review, with critics saying it is outdated and costly, and that improvements are long overdue. The Timms Review recommends changes to make the PIP system more humane and efficient, with over four million people affected annually. The first part of the Timms Review offers a range of improvements to the PIP claim process, some of which the government has already adopted.
The proposed reforms in the Timms Review have been criticised as minor adjustments rather than a comprehensive transformation of the system.
STORIES.imageAlt: A woman in a wheelchair sits at a desk typing on a laptop.

STORIES.headline: Shein to pay US$100 million to settle US shipping, customer service claims
STORIES.summary: Shein will pay $100 million to settle with the US FTC over allegations it misled consumers about shipping times, product reviews, and cotton sourcing.
article: Shein will pay $100 million to settle with the US FTC over allegations it misled consumers about shipping times, product reviews, and cotton sourcing. Shein agreed to stop misrepresenting shipping timelines and blocking negative customer reviews as part of the settlement. The FTC will use the settlement funds to reimburse affected customers impacted by deceptive claims.

Shein has agreed to pay $100 million to resolve FTC claims that it misled US shoppers on delivery times, reviews, and product origin. The FTC's lawsuit in California alleged Shein violated consumer trust by failing to deliver on promised shipping timelines.
STORIES.imageAlt: Shein agrees to $100 million settlement over US shopping claims

STORIES.headline: November's Beaver Moon Supermoon Rises Tonight
STORIES.summary: The November full moon, known as the Beaver Moon, appears fully lit as it aligns opposite the sun in the sky.
article: The November full moon, known as the Beaver Moon, appears fully lit as it aligns opposite the sun in the sky. The Beaver Moon is named for the time when beavers begin building lodges in preparation for winter, a tradition tied to the lunar cycle.

This full moon is part of a sequence of four consecutive supermoons, each up to 30% brighter and 14% larger than a typical full moon. A supermoon happens when the full moon reaches perigee, the closest point in its orbit to Earth. The November full moon, known as the Beaver Moon, will be a striking sight across the UK skies.
STORIES.imageAlt: Watch: 'Beaver Supermoon' lights up skies around the world

STORIES.headline: Astronomers discover oldest known quasar forming 630 million years after the Big Bang
STORIES.summary: Scientists believe the rapid formation of such a bright object supports the idea that early cosmic structures developed quickly.
article: Scientists believe the rapid formation of such a bright object supports the idea that early cosmic structures developed quickly.

The European Space Agency’s Euclid telescope has discovered a quasar forming just 630 million years after the Big Bang, surpassing its own earlier record. ESA researchers have published a study identifying the most distant quasar ever seen, dating back to 630 million years after the Big Bang. The quasar J1504+6252 formed 40 million years earlier than the one detected by Euclid in July.
STORIES.imageAlt: Astronomers discover oldest known quasar forming 630 million years after the Big Bang
